name: wp-frame-lite
description: Лёгкая стартовая WordPress-тема для небольших корпоративных сайтов.
author: Inveris <https://github.com/kirillye>

scripts.build: npm run images && vite build && npm run compress
scripts.bundle: dir-archiver --src . --dest ../wp-frame-lite.zip --exclude .DS_Store .git .gitattributes .github .gitignore .editorconfig .vscode .prettierrc.json .prettierignore .stylelintrc.json README.md composer.json composer.lock node_modules vendor package-lock.json package.json vite.config.js postcss.config.js phpcs.xml.dist scripts assets/css assets/js
